6.0.11.evidence: Newer Emscripten that the Maxima port author reported testing (ECL issue 860, 25 October 2026). Builds with it are experiments for the timing matrix, never releases.
6.0.11.emccFlagsEvidence: ECL links every wasm target with -sBINARYEN_EXTRA_PASSES=--spill-pointers. From 6.0.11 that pass aborts with 'getStackSpace: failed to find the stack pointer' unless the name section survives until wasm-opt. --emit-symbol-map keeps names for the intermediate Binaryen passes only and strips them from the final binary (the names go to a separate .symbols file). It is a link flag, so compile-only calls would warn; the warning is silenced.

emsdk.evidence: Official emsdk tag 6.0.11; emscripten-releases-tags.json maps it to the pinned release hash.

emscripten.evidence: Official source tag 6.0.11; emcc --version of the 6.0.11 SDK reports this commit.
